node.statement: Fix a finite r >= 1. Because M is smooth, its transition maps are C-infinity and hence C^r, so M is a C^r manifold. Because M is without boundary, its boundary Bd M is empty. The byte-matched Munkres Definition 1.1 external GT-munkres-edt-def-1.1-non-bounded states that when Bd M is empty, M is called non-bounded. Thus M satisfies the non-bounded C^r hypothesis of GT-munkres-edt-thm-10.6. That theorem therefore supplies a simplicial complex K and a C^r triangulation f: |K| -> M.
